budget_source_note: Budgets live in the manifest, keyed by event id. This file used to carry its own copy keyed by client-facing event name, and that duplication is what let plan-exit and pr-create go unmeasured: keyed by name both collapse onto pre-tool-use (TASK-123, ADR-030).
python_floor_evidence: python -c pass, p50 over 7 samples, Windows 11 / CPython 3.12.9, 2026-08-05. Machine-dependent: 124 ms was recorded on 2026-07-26 on a different machine. Named in hooks/hook_benchmark.py as MEASURED_INTERPRETER_FLOOR_MS.

recalibrated.method: budget = measured p95 x 1.5, rounded up to 50 ms; hard timeout = 2x that, capped at ADR-015's 2000 ms ceiling
recalibrated.host: python; the only host since ADR-029 retired the native binary
recalibrated.native_comparison: PreToolUse 20.2 ms native vs 273.6 ms python; SessionStart 24.6 vs 269.6
